nom: Personal Day Full Clarity Cleansing Powder

avis.texte: This has been my go to face wash since trying it in early 2025. Im skeptical of celebrity brands but i knew Lili Reinhart's troubles with acne so i was so excited to try it when i could. It did not disappoint!Its great for my acne prone skin, gentle enough to use morning and night, and lasts soooooooo long. And as someone else stated in reviews, i didnt have any purging with my skin when switching to this cleanser!!! I would use this on my entire body if they made a product for that (not getting my hopes up anytime soon as this is regularly out of stock on the brand's site and Ulta's).

I enjoy using this powder cleanser, it feels more gentle and less gritty than other powder cleansers I've used in the past. My one complaint is that I had to get the travel size because full size was sold out and it's NOT easy to get the product out of the mini travel size bottle. It's like the powder itself clogs up the small hole you're supposed to shake it from so after every shake I have to tap it on the counter to get the product away from clogging the exit. Small issue and I assume the full size is designed differently

avis.titre: Obsessed with the full clarity cleansing powder!!
avis.texte: I have seen a significant different in the texture of my skin and amount of breakouts I have had. I will be a customer for life!

I was intrigued by this being a powder. It works remarkably well and I don't feel like I'm wasting product. My partner and I have different skin needs (oily vs dry) and it helps both of us have calmer skin with fewer breakouts. As someone who washes their face in the shower, this is the ideal mechanism for me and I love the way my skin feels after using it.
This is the best cleanser I have used on my skin in years. It helps with my breakouts and makes my skin so smooth!
I love this powder. I have mild rosacea and sensitive skin and this powder is gentle. It also lasts a while!
Please restock!! I've been using this everyday after I workout as I find it cleanses very well without being drying or harsh at all. Please restock as I've already used it up!
Love that this cleansing powder does not dry out my sensitive skin!

I was skeptical about using a powder at first, never used this form of cleanser before. I love it! I double cleanse with it as it actually removes my makeup easily without me having to scrub it off. I feel like powder form lasts longer too.

This face wash has been so great for my pretty sensitive and acne-prone skin. It is very gentle, but because it goes from power to scrub it exfoliates the skin a bit as it dissolves fully- not enough to irritate/ strip my skin with daily use, but enough to leave it feeling so soft and refreshed. Hopefully the full size comes back soon!

This product is easy to use and lathers so nicely. It's also nourishing and calming and leaves the skin feeling so clean but not stripped of moisture. It's perfect for acne prone skin and I've noticed a clear up in my skin.
I'm obsessed with this stuff! I'm desperate for the full size to be back in stock!
I solely use this for my cleanser now since this is the only product that prevents developing acne compared to other brands. Highly recommend!

This is the most gentle and calming cleanser I've ever used especially on my sensitive skin and acne. I had to purchase a mini because I ran out but I hope the original size gets restocked soon! Usually other cleansers leave my skin feeling dry or irritated, even though they were marketed for sensitive skin. This cleanser is something I'll forever repurchase since it's so reliable and gentle!

I wasn't sure how I was going to feel about the powder cleanser but I absolutely love it. It lathers up extremely well even with just a small amount. I feel like my skin is staying clearer but also the cleanser still feels gentle on my dry skin.

avis.titre: The best cleansing powder on the market!
avis.texte: I love love love this cleansing powder!! The acne safe ingredients, the way it lathers and feels on your skin, the deep clean feeling I get every time I use it!! It's a 10/10 for me.

Love it ! I love how it's a powder so it's way easier to travel with. I just wish it was re stocked more often as of now I can't rely on it to be in stock so I can't put it consistently in my routine.
Love this cleanser. No fragrance, gentle but still deep cleansing. I use this when I feel like my skin needs it at night and is oilier than usual.
I love this cleansing powder!!! I use it everyday. Highly recommend. It has helped my acne.

avis.titre: I need the full size, I keep telling everyone about this.
avis.texte: I use this twice a day and need the larger size. It doesn't destroy my skin or make it more sensitive, it actually removes the yuck and relieves. I don't feel any sting. Sometimes my face is extra oily and I do have to go back over the t zone with a smidge more product but that's easy to do because the bottle only releases a little at a time. No waste. I'm obsessed though, because when I wash twice my skin doesn't notice it. No over drying effect or sensitivity because this powder is simultaneously strong and gentle. 100/10.

Really good product! The only thing is I wish that there were a little more physical exfoliant for texture when using the product. However, that is a preference, and others may find the current texture to be perfect! Did not break me out or cause inflammation to my existing acne. Definitely worth a try!

This is my absolute favorite cleanser! It's so gentle on my skin and keeps my acne at bay! My only problem is I can't get the full size… I've been buying the small one but I do not like the hole that dispenses the product. It doesn't like to come out and I have to bang it against the counter after a while.
Loved this face wash! Gentle on my skin while still exfoliating. And easy to travel with!

I have been using this cleanser for a LONG time! the only cleanser that works on my acne prone skin combo skin. I love how it is in powder form, how much it lathers etc. I am not really a fan of celebrity backed skincare lines but this is the only one that u know a fellow acne prone skin girly made it (Lili Reinhart!) i am a fan.
This has been a game changer for my severe acne. So easy to use and has really helped clear my face up.
Love his face wash and have been buying it since it came out, but have been waiting on a restock since December

I'd never used a powder cleanser until this one, and I don't think I can ever go back. It feels so good on my skin — gentle and yet you can feel it working. This + the moisturizer are as clean as my skin has ever felt without being dry. And my rosacea is the least noticeable I've ever seen it after using.
This first cleanser that makes my skin feel clean without making it feel dry. I also love how well the powder lathers.
So gentle, while also thoroughly cleaning my skin! Has helped cleared my acne and heal my skin barrier!

avis.titre: I love this cleanser, but it's crazy how long it's been out
avis.texte: I love this cleanser so much! Actually cleans but is super gentle. But it's been out of stock for months, and you have to buy 4 minis to equal the regular size, which makes it twice the price. I like it, but twice the price is making me think twice.
Honestly the only cleansor that feels like it actually keeps my acne in check. I've been waiting for them to restock the full sized version for months. Please!! I'm begging!!
Ive been using this cleanser for over a year and I love it!! I just wish they had more of the large size!!
I have really sensitive skin that tends to be acne-prone, and this product has been wonderful for effectively cleaning my face while be gentle and not drying out my face.

i have had acne since 12 years old (26 soon) and i have tried everything under the sun as an adult to help my hormonal jaw acne + my closed comedones. this + the anua azelic acid have absolutely changed my skin for the better. the ingredients are spot on and this is the most perfect face wash for my sensitive acne prone skin. the restock is taking so long im scared to try something else 😭 PLEASE RESTOCK and dont ever change the formula
The larger one has been out of stock but i love this cleanser so much ive been buying the minis, they still last a few weeks
I love this cleanser so much. I'm very prone to comedonal acne and this really helps keep them down. Only complaint is that it's out of stock! Also so easy to travel with since it's a powder.

I tried this as somewhat of a more affordable alternative to the Tatcha rice powder. It feels just as effective, but more gentle. I will continue to use it - just waiting for the full size to restock! This may seem obvious, but don't keep it in the shower as the moisture will ruin the dry powder. In terms of acne, it has not necessarily gotten rid of it, but I do feel like it's preventing new breakouts well.
This has been my favorite face wash I've ever found. With the light exfoliating texture it has made my skin so smooth!
Love it! Took a bit to get used to it being a powder, but it's really helped my skin. Hopefully the larger size will be restocked soon.

My skin instantly felt cleaner after the first use—it's gentle, yet powerful when it comes to my acne. I often get painful hormonal acne on my chin area and this is the first cleanser that feels like it's having an impact without irritating my skin. The small size actually lasts longer than you'd expect and I love the powder to lather consistency!

I have gone through 3 or 5 bottles of this. After being a Cerave user, this one works better for me. I love that it is in powder form and it is mild on my acne prone skin. I used to have breakouts or zits before but this one keeps my skin at bay. I did not feel any purging when I first used this. Lili Reinhart is also an oily acne prone skin girly, Im not a fan of celebrity brands but this one is an exemption.
Absolutely love this!! It's the only cleanser that has worked on my face!! But I'm waiting for the restock I only have a few washes left in the bottle will the restock be coming soon?
I love this product soo much! Waiting for the restock cause I'm almost out. :'( where's the restock?
Love this product! Recently showed it to my dermatologist and she also loves the ingredients in it!

I have really unusual skin. My pores are large but my skin is extremely dry. If I use a cleansing scrub it usually works for my pores but dries my skin out terribly. This powder works wonderfully on my skin! It cleans my pores but does not dry my skin at all. This is an an amazing product that has gained a new spot in my cleansing routine!!

This is a powder cleanser you mix with water in your hands before using. However, with the lid closed, this product turned to sludge in the bottle. My best guess is the humidity of being in the bathroom (but not the shower) was enough to turn the powder into a cream. The lid does not unscrew so I could not rescue any of the product. I ended up throwing it away. Sad. Waste of money. Perhaps better packaging would help. Glytone makes a powder cleanser and this has never happened to me with that product.

I bought this because my esthetician recommended using azaleic acid to help with my hormonal acne (late 30s). Prior to this I was using a salicylic acid cleaner in the AM, and PanOxyl benzoyl peroxide cleanser in the PM. This kept my acne (somewhat) controlled. For the last 2 weeks ive been using this clarity powder in the AM instead, and the amount of blackheads and closed comedones I have gotten on my neck and jawline is outta control! Now i have to go back for another facial earlier than I planned for extractions. This is the 2nd product from this brand that has been a let down. The Dive Deep moisturizer is also a fail- contains caprylic triglycerides (from coconut oil)- which made my skin 5x worse. After seeing reviews i had *such* high hopes for the brand but I will not buy another product from this line.
I love this cleansing powder! I wasn't sure about a powder face wash, but I love how gentle it is and it has lasted for a long time.
Love the powder to foaming action. Extremely satisfying and does a great job of cleansing the face.

I love this cleanser! The powder foams up very nicely and leaves your skin feeling so fresh and clean and smooth. I have noticed such a difference in my complexion as I typically am acne prone- this really cleared it up and kept acne away.
Clears my skin and love this powder. Only complaint is that it jams, the powder gets clumpy and the bottle twist opener is hard to use.

I've been wanting to try a cleansing powder and this brand caught my eye from all of the positive reviews. Unfortunately, this cleansing powder made mt skin feel dry, irritated, and broke me out bad. I will say the powder foams up into a nice consistency.

This broke me out SO bad, which was disappointing considering it is supposed to be for acne prone skin. The main ingredient is corn starch and when exposed to moisture creates a breeding ground for bacteria if not completely rinsed off.

I'm in my late 20's & suffer from hormonal acne. I've tried so many other cleansers and nothing was really helping. The cleansing powder feels so nice on my skin & I've noticed such a huge improvement. I've been using the cleansing powder + doing the work salicylic acid serum for about a month & love both products! I've already bought the moisturizer to get the full effect of the trio. Will definitely be repurchasing everything!
Works great. Refreshing, cleansing, and has a nice lather. Surprising how much I prefer this to other cleansers. (I will say that, at night, I usually have to use and rinse twice.)
love this soft exfoliating cleanser, foams up pretty good for a powder!

this cleansing powder is amazing! It has a gentle exfoliation which is great for my sensitive skin and doesn't make my cheeks red. & my skin feels so soft after using it, even before I apply my moisturizer and SPF! Will definitely reorder soon!
Super easy to travel with. A little goes a long way so it lasts a long time.

I spent a long time searching for a gentle yet exfoliating cleanser for my skin until i found this one! For reference i have dehydrated acne prone skin and this works awesomely. Cleansers usually leave my skin red but not this one!
Best cleansing product out there! I've tried a lot and this one really makes my skin feel so clean✨

I was worried this would feel like an exfoliating powder but when you add water to it it turns into a milky consistency. It cleanses without stripping or irritating my skin. Almost every cleanser ive tried leaves my fair skin pink but this one left my skin even and glowing! Its been my second cleanse since ive bought it and Im loving it!
I love this product! It does a fantastic job of cleansing my skin without drying it out. I wish there was more sustainable packaging or refillable packaging.
Everything breaks me out except this stuff. My skin feels clean and doesn't dry out after use. Exfoliates without overdoing it. Love!

I didn't know if this powder was going to work. I was even more skeptical as I rubbed the powder into my wet palms. However, I was pleasantly surprised! It formed a nice lather (not super soapy) and felt good on my skin. I let it sit for a couple of minutes while I brushed my teeth. After rinsing, my face felt and looked so clean! My 11 year old daughter uses it as well; it makes washing her face fun. We've become huge Personal Day fans!
Love the powder cleanser. Calms the redness on my face. Gives a good deep wash. Also nice for TSA since it isn't a liquid!
This is great for traveling and it made my skin super soft and is probably helping keep my acne at bay
This is the first face wash I've used in years that clears up and prevents breakouts on my chin!

By far the BEST cleanser i have ever used. I have very oily skin. Cleansers I've used in the past have left my face feeling extremely dry causing more oil or feeling just as oily as before. This powder actually gives my face the feeling of being clean doesn't dry out or leave it oily. I cant express how happy I am to finally have found something that really does work on my skin.

I have used powder cleansers before and I have always loved them. This however is the first one the consistently leave me skin smooth and does not make skin feel like it's stripped of all of its hydration. You need a lot less than you think. And I love that the cap twists so my the powder doesn't gunk up the outside of the bottle. I'm obsessed about to order my second bottle.
Haven't had a bad breakout since Ive been consistent with this face wash. Tried out the travel size first and it lasted months, so also such good value. Love this stuff
Really blown away by this product. Look no further! It is gentle and great on the skin!!

avis.titre: Personal Day has helped me so much!
avis.texte: As someone who has always struggled with acne, I've tried just about every skincare brand there is. A lot of frustration built up over the years because nothing seemed to work, but Personal Day changed my life. My skin is clearer & I feel more confident everyday while incorporating Personal Day into my routine. Thank you Lili & PD💚

I am obsessed with this cleanser! It forms a nice, silky lather and it doesn't make my skin feel stripped or dry, just clean. I'm 32 and I've tried every product under the sun to calm my skin and I've seen a huge difference since I started using Personal Day. I was skeptical of using a celebrity skin care brand, but not this one. This cleanser is the real deal.

My skin has been struggling with breakouts, congestion and excess oil for months after moving to another state with a very humid climate. This product has worked wonders! Little to no breakouts and my skin looks and feels so much better in general, I will forever repurchase.

I decided to try this after developing hormonal acne for the first time due to a change in birth control. I have been using this for a few weeks and have noticed a difference that I hope will continue to improve! My skin is really dry and this cleanser leaves my face feeling clean but not stripped. The powder is also so easy for traveling!

avis.titre: Love it as a night cleanser!
avis.texte: I love this cleanser for night time. I used to double cleanse with an oil cleanser and a water based cleanser at night, but now I feel super clean and do not feel the need to double cleanse anymore. It makes my skin soft and not stripped. The smell is also naturally pleasing.
So so good feel squeaky clean after and I feel like gives a glow
I love this stuff. It has changed my skin for the better and faded my dark spots.
My face is cleaner than it's ever been. I love that it's powder! Best face wash I've ever used!

I truly LOVE this cleanser. I have combination skin that tends to lean more dry, so it's tough for me to find a cleanser that doesn't dry me out, or end up making me too oily. This one leaves my face feeling truly clean and the moisturizer on top is perfection. I'm so glad I decided to try this brand :)
My skin loves this stuff, no more oily residue or wasting huge bottles of face wash. My boyfriend started using it too and we're glowing xoxo.

I started my Personal Day Journey with the mini starter set, and immediately ordered this in full size! I love how smooth it makes my skin feel, and I do think there is a bit of clearing and brightening happening! Love the travel friendly aspect as well.

I have combo skin, and it loves PD's full clarity cleansing powder! I can't wait to try more PD items. I love that Lili has amalgamated a team as passionate as her; I'm so excited to further support PD and its work.

This cleanser is on of the few that doesn't leave my skin feeling tight and it was noticeably softer and calmed my acne spots considerably after one use. After several uses I had few acne spots and the ones I did went away quickly. I like how there are multiple active ingredients so all I use after is a vitamin c treatment, moisturizer, and SPF. I really like the azelaic acid to help with rosacea, which I think I'm starting to have bc my mom has it really bad.
I love this cleansing powder! It's so fun to use & my face feels so clean after. I also love that it's acne safe!
I love how quickly the powder dissolves in your hands. Its really helped keep my acne under control.
This product is SO soft and I feel very refreshed after using it. I like that it isn't heavy like some cleansers. It doesn't leave my face feeling dry either : )

This cleanser performs really well. It is cleansing without leaving a tight or stripped feeling. The powder dissolves entirely so there are no harsh granules or microbeads. I would definitely purchase this again and it compares well to a similar cult favorite product Microfoliant" that is much more expensive. "

I have always struggled with acne, and especially in the last two years. I have been using this cleanser for 3 months and have noticed a huge improvement in my skin and I have tried A LOT of products. Will be buying more for sure!

I've tried other products like this but they have made my skin feel dry after using. I was hesitant to try this and I am glad I took a chance. This stuff is so nice! My face feels clean and brand new after every use. I love that it doesn't leave it dry like other products have in the past. Amazing!
Absolutely love this cleansing powder! Has helped start to clear my skin and it feels so clean without stripping my skin. I love the powder formula too it is easy to travel with. My new go to!

First time using the powder cleansing method and I am never going back to another method. I had really bad rosacea flareups especially during my period but event since using this miracle cleanser I have maintained a clear face and I am so grateful . The redness is almost totally gone. It's so gentle and fun to use. Thank you!!
This product cleared my skin in seriously TWO DAYS. Insane results!!

Never used a powder cleanser before, never NOT using a powder cleanser from now on. Specifically this one. Gentle with safe ingredients and the faintest exfoliation to really feel it cleaning your face.

I love this cleansing powder! It has made a world of difference for my face. Right before I started using it, I had a breakout across my entire forehead, spreading down to my temples, and also a breakout across my chin. This cleansing powder cleansed my face but also helped it stay hydrated, and the breakouts cleared up after not even a full week of using it! My nightly routine is to use this cleansing powder cleansing powder in the shower and then use the deep moisturizer right before bed. I tend to have oily skin, but it is dry in the winter so this face wash and moisturizer are the best products I've ever used. They keep my face clean and moisturized without being oily! Personal day is my go-to! Thank you, Lili, and Personal Day team for creating real working products!
absolutely in love with this. it has helped my smaller bumpy acne! I have raving to my friends about this stuff and will be buying my third bottle :)
The fash wash is such a nice experience. It lathers up well and leaves my face looking fresh and glass like.

avis.titre: The Best Cleansing Powder for Dry/Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I've always had insanely dry and sensitive skin. About two years ago, I randomly started struggling with acne for the first time in my twenties. It felt impossible to find a cleanser that targeted acne-prone skin but didn't strip my dry skin. I admit I was skeptical to try this product at first because I had never used a powder but boy I was wrong! This is the first cleanser that deep cleans my skin, doesn't dry it out, and keeps my skin so fresh and clear. It also keeps my pores clearer than ever. I will repurchase forever!

Love the texture and how easily it turns foamy. The thing I was most surprised about is how gentle it is. My skin is really reactive to everything and this does not irritate it at all. My skin feels fresh and clean without drying it out. Also love that there are no strong fragrances, I'm about to reorder!
I was previously using Dr sturm's powder cleanser but this is better. And you can travel with this size! Leaves your skin feeling clean and refreshed.

this is the first product i've tried from the line and it's an excellent face wash!! i love that it's in powder form. super easy to lather and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry after washing. 🙏🏻 highly recommend for acne prone skin!

I've been using the Full Clarity Cleansing Powder for almost a month now, and wow, the difference is amazing. When I first tried this product, I was a bit skeptical since I'd never used—or even heard of—a powder cleanser before. I'm so glad I gave it a chance! My skin looks noticeably clearer, and I'm thrilled that it's completely non-irritating.
I love this concept of a powdered cleanser. Why is this not more common?! It leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without stripping it of too much moisture. I'm never going back!
Super hydrating without feeling oily or heavy. Perfect for everyday use and looks great under makeup!

this is my new favorite cleanser. i thought it would be rough because of the powder, but its super hydrating and my skin feels clean, but plump and not tight after use. i also love the powder for getting extra exfoliation around dry areas like nose & chin. 10/10 reccommend!

I'm OBSESSED with the powder format because it's perfect for travel. It feels exfoliating but still super gentle and let me cut down on cleansing products during my recent trip. The formula foams up and helps take off grime and leftover makeup which is a nice bonus too. Definitely recommend :)

I absolutely love how it is a powder and then foams up with water! I love it even more that now I won't have to worry about getting travel sizes for my face wash! I hope their isn't any issue of the powder getting clumpy and stuck in the container after being in showers with the steam but time will tell. So far so good though!
